mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing discount rates on future corporate cash flows and increasing equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during periods of declining FEDFUNDS (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll growth above 150k per month signals strong labor market demand, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when PAYEMS exceeds 150k for three consecutive months (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both residential investment (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) indicates broad-based demand expansion, which increases corporate revenue visibility and supports equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both HOUST and RSAFS rise simultaneously (t-test p > 0.05), or interaction Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0 for two consecutive months signals weakening supply capacity, which may trigger inflationary pressures in the short term and prompt monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO remains below 100.0 for two months (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the CPIAUCSL above 2.5% year-over-year signals persistent inflation, increasing the likelihood of Fed rate hikes, which raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when CPIAUCSL YoY growth exceeds 2.5% (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both GDP growth (GDPC1) and residential investment (HOUST) signals a weakening demand environment, reducing corporate revenue expectations and increasing risk aversion, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both GDPC1 and HOUST decline simultaneously (t-test p > 0.05), or interaction Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 6.0% combined with rising non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates a tightening labor market, increasing wage pressures and inflation expectations, which may prompt Fed rate hikes and lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when UNRATE < 6.0 and PAYEMS > 137000.0 (t-test p > 0.05), or interaction Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0 combined with a rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 0.5% signals a supply shock during a monetary tightening cycle, increasing uncertainty and reducing corporate profitability, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO < 100.0 and FEDFUNDS > 0.5% (t-test p > 0.05), or interaction Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
